description: Returns the details of one story in the Hero of You catalogue: who it suits, the age range, occasions, the three chapter previews, published sample pictures, who else can appear in the book, the printed formats it comes in (hardcover, softcover) and the link to the story page. Use when someone wants to know more about a specific story, by its id (e.g. "dinosaurs") or title.

story_id.description: The story id, e.g. "dinosaurs" or "space", or its exact title

name: get_story
title: Read one children's story's details
